name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (+ DPDP Rules 2025)
source_document: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023)

controls.title: Notice / purpose transparency
controls.description: Provide a clear notice describing the personal data processed and the purposes.

controls.title: Consent capture and purpose linkage
controls.description: Obtain and record consent that is linked to specific, declared purposes.

controls.title: Consent withdrawal workflow
controls.description: Provide an easy mechanism for a Data Principal to withdraw consent.

controls.title: Data Principal rights request mechanism
controls.description: Operate a mechanism to receive and act on access, correction and erasure requests.

controls.title: Encryption / obfuscation / tokenisation safeguards
controls.description: Apply encryption, obfuscation or tokenisation to protect personal data.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Restrict access to personal data to authorised persons on a need-to-know basis.

controls.title: Logging / monitoring / review
controls.description: Maintain logs and monitor access to detect and investigate unauthorised processing.

controls.title: Backup / availability / recovery
controls.description: Maintain backups to ensure continued availability and recovery of personal data.

controls.title: Security obligations in processor contracts
controls.description: Ensure processors are bound by contract to implement reasonable security safeguards.

controls.title: Personal data breach detection and response
controls.description: Detect, contain and respond to personal data breaches.

controls.title: Affected Data Principal notification readiness
controls.description: Be able to notify the Board and affected Data Principals of a breach.

controls.title: Purpose-based retention
controls.description: Retain personal data only as long as necessary for the declared purpose.

controls.title: Deletion / erasure execution
controls.description: Execute deletion/erasure when retention periods lapse or consent is withdrawn.

controls.title: Child-data consent / age verification workflow
controls.description: Obtain verifiable parental consent before processing a child's personal data.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments.

controls.title: Periodic audit
controls.description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must undergo periodic independent data audits.

controls.title: Processor/vendor governance
controls.description: Engage Data Processors only under a valid contract and govern their processing.

controls.title: Cross-border data-flow governance
controls.description: Govern transfers of personal data outside India per applicable restrictions.

controls.title: Privacy contact / responsible person information
controls.description: Publish contact information of the Data Protection Officer or responsible person.

controls.title: Enhanced security safeguards (DPDP Rules)
controls.description: Enhanced technical security safeguards introduced by the DPDP Rules, effective later.
